description: This Java source file defines the main activity of an Android application called PhoneMainActivity. It manages user interactions such as selecting a date, displays GPS tracks on a map, and handles asynchronous data loading for location entries. The class sets up a Google Map, responds to date picker events, and visualizes GPS points as polylines, providing map-based visualization of location data per selected date.

classes.name: PhoneMainActivity
classes.description: Main activity for an Android app that displays GPS tracks on a map, allows date selection, and updates the map accordingly.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and prepares the map fragment.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Displays a date picker dialog to select a date.

methods.name: onDateSet
methods.description: Handles the date selected by the user, formats it, updates UI, and triggers track display.

methods.name: showTrack
methods.description: AsyncTask that loads location data for the chosen date and updates the map with the track.

methods.name: onMapReady
methods.description: Callback to initialize the GoogleMap instance when ready.
